Libraries
```{r}
library(car)
library(tidyverse)
library(emmeans)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(rptR)
library(writexl)
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
```

Data
```{r}
# Read in data
data_spin_trials <- read.csv("Data.csv")

# Add variables and filters

# Add trial number
data_spin_trials <- data_spin_trials %>%
  group_by(id_number) %>%
  mutate(trial = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(trial = factor(trial))

# Add activity variable
data_spin_trials$total_turn <- data_spin_trials$left_turn + data_spin_trials$right_turn 

# Add fix_mix variable
data_spin_trials$fix_mix <- ifelse(data_spin_trials$environment %in% c("l", "r"), "fixed", ifelse(data_spin_trials$environment == "m", "mixed", NA))

# Filter turn_total >=3
data_spin_trials <- data_spin_trials %>% filter(total_turn >= 3)

# Calculate raw directional and absolute laterality 
data_spin_trials$lat_count <- data_spin_trials$right_turn - data_spin_trials$left_turn
data_spin_trials$abs_lat <- abs(data_spin_trials$lat_count)

# Calculate laterality adjusted for the total number of revolutions
data_spin_trials$lat_prop <- data_spin_trials$lat_count / data_spin_trials$total_turn
data_spin_trials$abs_lat_prop <- abs(data_spin_trials$lat_prop)

# Save data with new variables
write_xlsx(data_spin_trials, "data_spin_trials.xlsx")

#create male and female dfs
male1 <- data_spin_trials %>% filter(sex == "m")
female1 <- data_spin_trials %>% filter(sex == "f")

# Number of trials (post-filter) by morph, environment, and sex
trial_counts <- data_spin_trials %>%
  count(morph, environment, sex) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = sex,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0,
    names_prefix = "n_"
  ) %>%
  arrange(morph, environment)

print(trial_counts)

sum(data_spin_trials %>% count(morph, environment, sex) %>% pull(n))
```

(Repeatablility) Is behavior repeatable?
```{r}
# Filter only individuals with two trials represented
data_spin_trials_paired <- data_spin_trials %>%
  group_by(id_number) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>%
  ungroup()

# Calculate repeatability for directional laterality
repeatability <- rpt(lat_count ~ sex + trial + (1 | id_number), grname = "id_number", data = data_spin_trials_paired, datatype = "Gaussian")
summary(repeatability)

# Calculate repeatability for absolute laterality
repeatabilityb <- rpt(abs_lat ~ sex + trial + (1 | id_number), grname = "id_number", data = data_spin_trials_paired, datatype = "Gaussian")
summary(repeatabilityb)

# Repeatability after accounting for total revolutions
repeatability_prop <- rpt(lat_prop ~ sex + trial + (1 | id_number), grname = "id_number", data = data_spin_trials_paired, datatype = "Gaussian")
summary(repeatability_prop) ## MODEL REFERENCED IN MS

repeatabilityb_prop <- rpt(abs_lat_prop ~ sex + trial + (1 | id_number), grname = "id_number", data = data_spin_trials_paired, datatype = "Gaussian")
summary(repeatabilityb_prop) ## MODEL REFERENCED IN MS

```

(Absolute laterality) Do all groups show lateralized behavior?
```{r}

### Linear Mixed Models ###

# m1.
abs_m1 <- lmer(abs_lat ~ sex + environment + trial + (1|id_number), data = data_spin_trials)
summary(abs_m1)
anova(abs_m1, type = 3) 

# m2. We test for an interaction.
abs_m2 <- lmer(abs_lat ~ sex * fix_mix + trial + (1|id_number), data = data_spin_trials)
summary(abs_m2)
anova(abs_m2, type = 3)

# m3. Using the total-adjusted measures
abs_m3 <- lmer(abs_lat_prop ~ sex + environment + trial + (1|id_number), data = data_spin_trials)
summary(abs_m3)
anova(abs_m3, type = 3) ## MODEL REFERENCED IN SUPLIMENTARY MATERIAL

# m2. We test for an interaction. 
abs_m4 <- lmer(abs_lat_prop ~ sex * fix_mix + trial + (1|id_number), data = data_spin_trials)
summary(abs_m4)
anova(abs_m4, type = 3) ## MODEL REFERENCED IN MS

```

(Absolute Laterality) Simple plots
```{r}

# CIs from abs_m3
abs_m3_emm <- emmeans(abs_m3, ~ environment * sex) %>% as.data.frame()

plot_abs_m3 <- ggplot() +
  # Raw trial-level observations
  geom_point(data = data_spin_trials, aes(x = environment,y = abs_lat_prop, color = sex, group = sex),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.12, jitter.height = 0, dodge.width = 0.4), alpha = 0.3, size = 1.5) +
  # Model-estimated 95% confidence intervals
  geom_errorbar(data = abs_m3_emm, aes( x = environment, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, color = sex, group = sex),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.4), width = 0.08, linewidth = 0.9) +
  # Model-estimated marginal means
  geom_point(data = abs_m3_emm, aes(x = environment, y = emmean, color = sex, shape = sex, group = sex),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.4), size = 3.5 ) +
  coord_flip(ylim = c(0, 1))+
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Environment", y = "Absolute laterality", color = "Sex", shape = "Sex")

plot_abs_m3
```

(Directional laterality for MALES) Do all groups show lateralized behavior in the same direcion?
```{r}
### Generalized Linear Mixed Models ###

# m1. environment and morph
dir_m1 <- glmer(cbind(right_turn, left_turn) ~ environment + morph + trial + (1|id_number), data = male1, family = binomial)
summary(dir_m1)
Anova(dir_m1, type=3) ## MODEL REFERENCED IN SUPLIMENTARY MATERIAL
isSingular(dir_m1)
VarCorr(dir_m1)

observed_male_cells <- male1 %>% distinct(environment, morph)

dir_m1_emm <- emmeans(dir_m1, ~ environment * morph, type = "response") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  inner_join(observed_male_cells, by = c("environment", "morph")) %>%
  mutate(emmean = 2 * prob - 1,
         lower.CL = 2 * asymp.LCL - 1,
         upper.CL = 2 * asymp.UCL - 1)

# Simple plot
plot_dir_m1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  # Raw trial-level observations
  geom_point(data = male1, aes(x = environment, y = lat_prop, color = morph, group = morph),
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.12, jitter.height = 0, dodge.width = 0.4),
             alpha = 0.3, size = 1.5) +
  # Model-estimated 95% confidence intervals
  geom_errorbar(data = dir_m1_emm,
                aes(x = environment, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, color = morph, group = morph),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.4), width = 0.08, linewidth = 0.9) +
  # Model-estimated marginal means
  geom_point(data = dir_m1_emm,
             aes(x = environment, y = emmean, color = morph, group = morph),
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.4), size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip(ylim = c(-1, 1)) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Environment composition", y = "Directional laterality", color = "Morph")

plot(plot_dir_m1)


# m2. fix_mix and morph
dir_m2 <- glmer(cbind(right_turn, left_turn) ~ fix_mix * morph + trial + (1|id_number), data = male1, family = binomial)
summary(dir_m2)
Anova(dir_m2, type=3) ## MODEL REFERENCED IN MS
isSingular(dir_m2)
VarCorr(dir_m2)

dir_m2_emm <- emmeans(dir_m2, ~ fix_mix * morph, type = "response") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(emmean = 2 * prob - 1,
         lower.CL = 2 * asymp.LCL - 1,
         upper.CL = 2 * asymp.UCL - 1)

# Simple plot
plot_dir_m2 <- ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  # Raw trial-level observations
  geom_point(data = male1, aes(x = fix_mix, y = lat_prop, color = morph, group = morph),
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.12, jitter.height = 0, dodge.width = 0.4),
             alpha = 0.3, size = 1.5) +
  # Model-estimated 95% confidence intervals
  geom_errorbar(data = dir_m2_emm,
                aes(x = fix_mix, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, color = morph, group = morph),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.4), width = 0.08, linewidth = 0.9) +
  # Model-estimated marginal means
  geom_point(data = dir_m2_emm,
             aes(x = fix_mix, y = emmean, color = morph, group = morph),
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.4), size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip(ylim = c(-1, 1)) +
```

(Directional laterality for FEMALES) Do all groups show lateralized behavior in the same direcion?
```{r}
### Generalized Linear Mixed Models ###

# f1. environment (3 level)
dir_f1 <- glmer(cbind(right_turn, left_turn) ~ environment + trial + (1 | id_number), data = female1, family = binomial)
summary(dir_f1) 
Anova(dir_f1, type = 3) ## MODEL REFERENCED IN MS
isSingular(dir_f1)
VarCorr(dir_f1)

# Pairwise environment comparisons following significant omnibus test
dir_f1_emm <- emmeans(dir_f1, ~ environment, type = "response")
pairs(dir_f1_emm, adjust = "tukey")

# Simple plot
dir_f1_emm <- emmeans(dir_f1, ~ environment, type = "response") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    emmean = 2 * prob - 1,
    lower.CL = 2 * asymp.LCL - 1,
    upper.CL = 2 * asymp.UCL - 1
)

plot_dir_f1 <- ggplot() +

             position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0),
             alpha = 0.3, size = 1.5) +
  # Model-estimated 95% confidence intervals
  geom_errorbar(data = dir_f1_emm,
                aes(x = environment, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, color = environment),
                width = 0.08, linewidth = 0.9) +
```

(Directional laterality) Do all groups show lateralized behavior in either direction?
```{r}
### T-tests ###

# Average trial values for each individual
ind_means <- data_spin_trials %>%
  group_by(id_number) %>%
  summarise(
    environment = first(environment),
    class = first(class),
    meanlat = mean(lat_prop, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop" )

# T-Tests with holm correction
results1 <- ind_means %>%
  group_by(class) %>%
  summarise(t_test = list(t.test(
    meanlat, mu = 0, conf.level = 0.95
  )), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(tidy_result = purrr::map(t_test, broom::tidy)) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(tidy_result) %>%
  mutate(p_adjusted = p.adjust(p.value, method = "holm"),
         significant = p_adjusted < 0.05)

print(results1)

#results1_export <- results1 %>% select(-t_test)
#write_xlsx(results1_export, "results1.xlsx")
```

(Directional Laterality) Final plot
```{r}
class_order <- c("ml_f", "ml_m", "mr_f", "mr_m", "f_l", "f_r", "f_m")

combined_emm <- bind_rows(
  dir_m2_emm %>% mutate(Sex = "Males"),   
  dir_f1_emm %>% mutate(Sex = "Females")   
) %>%
  mutate(
    Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Males", "Females")),
    class = case_when(
      Sex == "Females" ~ paste0("f_", environment),                       # f_l, f_r, f_m
      Sex == "Males"   ~ paste0("m", morph, "_", substr(fix_mix, 1, 1))   # ml_f, ml_m, mr_f, mr_m
    ),
    class = factor(class, levels = rev(class_order))
  )

data_plot <- data_spin_trials %>%
  mutate(class = factor(class, levels = rev(class_order)))

# Final plot
ggplot() +
  
  geom_boxplot(
    data = data_plot,
    aes(y = class, x = lat_prop, fill = environment),
alpha = 0.2, color = "#636363") +
  
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed") +
  
  geom_errorbarh(
    data = combined_emm,
    aes(
      y = class,
      xmin = lower.CL,
      xmax = upper.CL),
    height = 0,
    linewidth = 1.2) +
    
  geom_point(
    data = combined_emm,
    aes(y = class, x = emmean),
    size = 3.5) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      l = "darkblue",
      r = "darkred",
      m = "black")) +
  
    scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      l = "darkblue",
      r = "darkred",
      m = "lightgrey")) +
  
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = c(
      ml_f = "Male l / Fixed",
      ml_m = "Male l / Mixed",
      mr_f = "Male r / Fixed",
      mr_m = "Male r / Mixed",
      f_l = "Female / l",
      f_r = "Female / r",
      f_m = "Female / m")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Laterality proportion",
    y = NULL ) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```

(Absolute Laterality) Final plot
```{r}
fms_levels <- c("f_f", "f_m", "m_f", "m_m")

add_fix_mix_sex <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(fix_mix_sex = factor(paste(sex, substr(fix_mix, 1, 1), sep = "_"),
                                levels = fms_levels))
}

data_spin_trials <- add_fix_mix_sex(data_spin_trials)
abs_m4_emm       <- add_fix_mix_sex(abs_m4_emm)

# Final plot
ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(
    data = data_spin_trials,
    aes(
      y = fix_mix_sex,
      x = abs_lat_prop,
      fill = fix_mix
    ),
    alpha = 0.2,
    color = "#636363"
  ) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    data = abs_m4_emm,
    aes(
      y = fix_mix_sex,
      xmin = lower.CL,
      xmax = upper.CL
    ),
    height = 0,
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = abs_m4_emm,
    aes(
      y = fix_mix_sex,
      x = emmean
    ),
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      fixed = "black",
      mixed = "lightgrey"
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Absolute laterality",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
